name: Rhododendron
desc: Shrubs that dominate the slopes at roughly 4,000 to 5,000 m together with juniper, according to Wikipedia on the park.
about: Rhododendron, from Ancient Greek ῥόδον (rhódon), meaning "rose", and δένδρον (déndron), meaning "tree", is a very large genus of about 1,024 species of woody plants in the heath family (Ericaceae).
